# Data Quality

This folder covers the integrity, completeness, and accuracy of records within the Danish Acute Surgery Database (AKDB). It documents specific data quality anomalies identified across annual reports, such as patient exclusions caused by invalid CPR numbers, regional disparities in missing clinical information, and numerical discrepancies between reported national surgical totals and recorded timestamps.

## Pages

- [[data-quality|Data Quality]] — Details specific data anomalies and completeness issues in the AKDB, including invalid CPR numbers, regional variations in missing data (notably in Region Midtjylland), and mismatches in patient counts for surgical indicators.
